worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.summary: Strip the steel from your own body into one heavy lance: it hits the first enemy in the corridor and knocks it back, and the user pays a fixed slice of maximum health whether or not it connects.
The lance deals %1$s Steel special damage, reaches %2$s blocks, is %3$s blocks half-wide, and only strikes the nearest first target.
On a hit it knocks the target %1$s blocks along the lance; casting costs a fixed %2$s of maximum health regardless of the result.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.temper.on: Tempered: shed only the outer layer for 65% of the cost, but the lance is lighter in power, length and width.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.temper.off: Full shed: press the whole plate into the shot for more power, length and width, at the full health cost.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the lance power steps up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the lance power reaches %2$s and the health cost rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.use.0: Forge your own steel into one heavy lance
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.use.1: Trade a fixed slice of health for one heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.use.2: Hit the first body in front and knock it away
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.preference.t: On: shed only the outer layer for 65% of the health cost, but power ×0.9, length ×0.82 and width ×0.8 - you keep yourself, but hard targets survive. Off (full shed): press the whole plate into the shot for power ×1.1 and a longer, thicker lance at the full health cost.
worldcombat.skill.steelbeam.preference.a: Above this distance the companion closes in before firing. Higher fires sooner and wastes the health cost more often.
Below this health fraction the companion stops firing (unless the target is nearly down). Lower spends health more freely and risks stripping itself to the danger line.
